goals.title: Crate Readiness Rubric, Inventory, and Matrix
goals.objective: Create the crate-by-crate production-readiness audit framework before editing crates. Enumerate every workspace crate from cargo metadata and crates/*, define the readiness rubric, define required per-crate artifacts under docs/quality/crate-readiness/<crate>.md, create an aggregate matrix artifact, map each crate to exactly one tranche goal, and record baseline dependency and feature-flag topology. Rubric must cover manifest correctness, dependency direction, feature flags, public API, error handling, runtime behavior, test coverage, docs/examples, wiring through service-api/cli/mcp/xtask where applicable, scaffold/dead-code/fallback scans, security/reliability risks, and a production-readiness verdict.

goals.title: Core Contracts, Event, Session, and Replay Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-core, tdw-domain, tdw-protocol, tdw-config, tdw-event, tdw-actor, tdw-bus, tdw-cdc, tdw-outbox, tdw-snapshot, tdw-replay, tdw-rollout, and tdw-session. For each crate, produce its readiness artifact, verify manifest/dependencies/features, ensure API and error contracts are production-shaped, add or improve tests and docs where evidence is weak, remove scaffold-only or masking fallback behavior, and confirm downstream wiring into dependent crates.

goals.title: Data, Storage, Pipeline, and SQL Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-dbt-runner, tdw-migration, tdw-pipe, tdw-pipeline, tdw-sql-codegen, tdw-stage, tdw-table-format, tdw-storage-clickhouse, tdw-storage-fs, tdw-storage-meilisearch, tdw-storage-parquet, tdw-storage-postgres, tdw-storage-qdrant, tdw-storage-router, and tdw-storage-s3. For each crate, prove production readiness around data contracts, storage boundaries, SQL/export correctness, checksums/idempotency, error handling, test coverage, docs, dependency/feature configuration, and clean-room constraints.

goals.title: Provider, Embedding, and Model Adapter Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-provider-alpaca, tdw-provider-binance, tdw-provider-fileset, tdw-provider-fred, tdw-provider-huggingface, tdw-provider-polygon, tdw-provider-ws-mock, tdw-provider-yahoo, tdw-embed, tdw-embed-local, tdw-embed-openai, tdw-embed-google, tdw-llm, tdw-llm-anthropic, and tdw-llm-openai-compat. For each crate, verify provider/model contracts, deterministic tests or mocked boundaries, credentials/config behavior, feature/dependency shape, documentation, error handling, and absence of untested live-network assumptions.

goals.title: Agent, Auth, Hooks, Tools, and UDF Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-agent, tdw-agent-store, tdw-auth, tdw-auth-oidc, tdw-define, tdw-hooks, tdw-mask, tdw-tools, tdw-sandbox, tdw-udf, tdw-udf-external, tdw-udf-js, tdw-udf-python, and tdw-udf-wasm. For each crate, assess production-grade auth/tool/hook/UDF behavior, permission boundaries, schema/golden tests, adversarial/security tests where relevant, feature flags, docs, wiring into runtime/service surfaces, and fallback/dead-code risk.

goals.title: Knowledge, Graph, Tags, ML, Eval, and Utility Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-entity-resolver, tdw-eval-runner, tdw-feature-store, tdw-fn-string, tdw-graph, tdw-kg, tdw-knowledge, tdw-ml-registry, tdw-rewrite, tdw-spatial, tdw-tag-rules, tdw-tags, tdw-test-utils, and tdw-workflow-engine. For each crate, verify correctness contracts, graph/tag/model/eval behavior, malformed-input handling, tests and docs, dependency and feature shape, and complete wiring into higher-level services where intended.

goals.title: Client, Service, MCP, ACP, Runtime, and Worker Crates
goals.objective: Audit and harden these crates one by one: tdw-acp, tdw-app-client, tdw-app-server, tdw-cli, tdw-exec, tdw-mcp, tdw-runtime, tdw-service, tdw-service-api, tdw-tui, and tdw-worker. For each crate, prove thin-client/service wiring, protocol event consumption, daemon/queue/runtime behavior, CLI/MCP/TUI output behavior, docs, tests, dependencies/features, and functional integration without duplicate business logic or scaffold-only paths.

goals.title: Aggregate Production Readiness Gate
goals.objective: Verify the full crate-by-crate audit and hardening run. Confirm every workspace crate has a readiness artifact and a verdict in the aggregate matrix, confirm every blocker has either been fixed or recorded as a durable follow-up, update docs/quality/release-readiness-summary.md or an equivalent crate-readiness summary, run targeted verification plus cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p xtask -- clean-room-audit, git diff --check, run ai-slop-cleaner on changed files, rerun verification, and complete code-review only when recommendation is APPROVE and architectStatus is CLEAR.
